title: Zeus to The Rock, starting with a Rubens painting
description:
A Rubens painting, four centuries of French rulers and a Kremlin handshake connect the king of the Greek gods to Dwayne Johnson.

Zeus → Henry IV of France → Emmanuel Macron → Vladimir Putin → Barack Obama → Ash Carter → Kevin Hart → The Rock

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
